title: 第25章 演武堂切磋展露实力第26章 擂台对决碾压周弘
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 晨光破晓，晨雾渐渐消散在青岚宗山间。
朝阳升起，金辉洒落外门连绵屋舍，山间灵气愈发浓郁。
林宸晨起在院中吐纳修行，练完流云步与裂风掌。
气息收稳，心境平和，周身炼气四层的修为内敛深藏，不显半分凌厉。
闭门苦修多日，境界已然稳固在炼气四层。
各类功法招式炉火纯青，肉身底蕴远超同阶，再一味闭门打坐，反倒容易局限眼界。
适当与人交手切磋，磨练临场应变，见识各路修士招式路数，也是修行必经之路。
心念既定，林宸简单整理衣衫，缓步走出小院。
沿着青石山道，朝着外门演武堂方向行去。
外门演武堂坐落在外门区域正中位置，占地极为宽阔。
场内开辟十数座小型比试擂台，供外门弟子日常演武、切磋较技。
四周设有观礼石阶，可供弟子驻足观战，互相论道点评。
每日清晨开始，演武堂内便人声鼎沸，热闹不休。
有独自练拳演武打磨根基的弟子，有邀约同门登台比试较量的修士。
也有不少闲来无事之人，围在擂台旁观战凑热闹，议论场上强弱。
弱肉强食，强者受人敬重，弱者只能默默旁观。
演武堂，便是外门弟子暗中比拼底蕴、显露天赋的地方。
林宸缓步走入演武堂，目光平静扫过场内景象。
一座座擂台上，都有弟子两两对战，拳掌交错，灵力激荡。
招式有刚猛霸道，有灵动飘忽，路数各不相同。
四周围观之人凝神观望，时不时低声点评几句。
他没有急于登台，而是走到僻静的石阶角落，静静伫立观望。
打算先看看外门同门的实战风格、惯用招式与出手套路。
知己知彼，方能在切磋之中从容应对，不露破绽。
目光扫过几座擂台，林宸默默观察。
外门弟子大多修习基础修行功法，招式套路死板，临场应变不足。
比拼多半靠修为硬压，缺少真正的搏杀技巧与身法配合。
就算是一些炼气四层的老牌弟子，打法也中规中矩，破绽颇多。
以林宸的眼界来看，这些交手水准，只能算是粗浅入门，不值深究。
就在他静静观望之时，一道略显尴尬的声音在身旁响起。
“这位师弟，可是新晋入外门的林宸？”
林宸转头望去，只见一名面容温和的少年立在身旁。
衣着整洁，气息平稳，修为稳在炼气四层，神色谦和有礼。
正是当初和他一同通过考核的新晋弟子，为人敦厚和善，名叫许凡。
许凡性子老实，待人谦和，平日里从不与人争执，潜心修行。
他早就听闻林宸实力强横，连老牌弟子周磊都奈何不得。
content_en:
The morning light breaks, and the morning fog gradually dissipates in the Qinglan Sect Mountain.
The morning sun rises, and the golden light shines on the outer gates of the continuous houses, and the aura of the mountains becomes more and more intense.
Lin Chen got up in the morning to practice breathing in the courtyard, and finished practicing Flowing Cloud Step and Splitting Wind Palm.
The breath is calm, the mood is peaceful, and the cultivation of the fourth level of Qi refining around the body is restrained and deep, not showing any sharpness.
After practicing hard for many days behind closed doors, his state has stabilized at the fourth level of Qi refining.
The various techniques and moves are extremely proficient, and the physical foundation is far beyond the same level. If you just meditate behind closed doors, your horizons will easily be limited.
Appropriate competition with others, honing on-the-spot responses, and seeing the moves of various monks are also the only way to practice.
With his mind set, Lin Chen simply arranged his clothes and walked out of the small courtyard slowly.
Walk along the Qingshi Mountain Road towards the outer gate of the martial arts hall.
The outer gate martial arts hall is located in the middle of the outer gate area and covers an extremely wide area.
A dozen small competition arenas have been opened in the venue for outer disciples to practice martial arts and compare skills on a daily basis.
There are stone steps surrounding the ceremony, where disciples can stop to watch the battle and comment on each other's teachings.
Starting every morning, the martial arts hall is bustling with people and bustling.
There are disciples who practice boxing and martial arts on their own to hone their foundation, and there are monks who invite fellow disciples to compete on stage.
There were also many people who had nothing to do, gathered around the ring to watch the fight and join in the fun, discussing the strength and weakness of the field.
The weak eat the strong, the strong are respected, and the weak can only watch silently.
The martial arts hall is a place where outer sect disciples compete in secret and reveal their talents.
Lin Chen walked slowly into the martial arts hall, his eyes calmly scanning the scene inside.
In each arena, there are disciples fighting in pairs, with fists and palms interlaced, and spiritual power surging.
The moves range from fierce and domineering to agile and erratic, with different styles.
The people around looked attentively and commented in low voices from time to time.
He did not rush to the stage, but walked to a secluded corner of the stone steps and stood quietly watching.
I plan to first take a look at the actual combat style, common moves and tricks of the outer sect.
Only when you know yourself and the enemy can you deal with it calmly without revealing any flaws in the discussion.
Lin Chen silently observed as his eyes swept across several arenas.
Most of the outer sect disciples practice basic cultivation techniques, with rigid routines and insufficient adaptability on the spot.
Most of the competition relies on hard pressure based on cultivation, lacking real fighting skills and physical coordination.
Even some veteran disciples at the fourth level of Qi Refining have quite satisfactory playing styles with many flaws.
From Lin Chen's perspective, these levels of competition can only be regarded as a superficial introduction and not worthy of further study.
While he was watching quietly, a slightly embarrassed voice sounded beside him.
"This junior brother is Lin Chen who has just joined the outer sect?"
Lin Chen turned around and saw a young man with a gentle face standing next to him.
The clothes are neat, the aura is stable, the cultivation level is stable at the fourth level of Qi refining, and the look is modest and polite.
It was the new disciple who passed the examination with him, who was honest and kind, named Xu Fan.
Xu Fan has an honest temperament and is courteous to others. He never quarrels with others and devotes himself to spiritual practice.
He had long heard that Lin Chen was so powerful that even veteran disciple Zhou Lei could do nothing about it.
